0.q: A locus associated with leaf sodium content was identified on chromosome 4HL; the suggested candidate gene was HKT1;5, a high-affinity potassium transporter. The increased salinity tolerance may be achieved by HKT1;5 retrieving Na+ from the xylem sap at the root level.

1.q: A locus on chromosome 7HS called HvNax3 explained up to 25% of the leaf sodium content; the suggested candidate gene underlying this locus was HVP10, a vacuolar H+-translocating pyrophosphatase.
